title: task
description: A backlog task file (products/<slug>/backlog/T-xxxx.yaml). Only fields the dispatcher reads are listed; others are allowed.

data_request.description: Analyst research task (owner 28.11): keyword data the dispatcher fetches before the run (team/keywords.py) — keywords (phrases), locations (gb, us, ie, all), sources (google_ads_volume, ranked_keywords, bing_keyword, bing_related), competitors (domains), include (filter words); paid calls within product.yaml keywords.dataforseo_cap_usd.

data.description: Set by the dispatcher: the last fetch of data_request (key, file, spent_usd, refused).

visible.description: The task changes what a player or reader SEES (a screen, its layout, visuals, on-screen text). With cycle.visible.review_before_merge it is reviewed on its branch and merged only by a pass.

redesign.description: It changes the layout, size or look of a screen that already exists. Owner 26.11: a redesign comes only with a new function.

new_function.description: What the player can newly do thanks to this change; a redesign without it waits in `proposed` for the owner (cycle.visible.redesign_gate).

pre_merge.description: Set by the dispatcher: the task is in `review` with its commit still on task/<id>, not merged and not deployed.

plan.description: Marketer: the deliverable is products/<slug>/marketing-plan.md (a week of slots per channel), not a post; the task is accepted by that file.

repo_only.description: The deliverable is not served publicly (code, tests, docs). The reviewer runs in a read-only checkout of released_sha with Read/Glob/Grep, python3 -m unittest (also -v, tests.<module>, discover -s <dir>), python3 -m pytest -q, git log -1 and team-fetch.
